reviewer: Codex; one LLM-assisted manual reviewer; no independent second semantic adjudicator
phase_durations: Not separately instrumented. Work included inventory, heuristic implementation, bounded diff screening, accepted source tracing, artifact generation and audits.
execution: Only own standard-library scripts via /usr/bin/python3 -I -B and read-only Git. No upstream checkout/code/build/hook execution, no network, no blind package/key access.
manual_screen_limit: Large rejected/deferred diffs were screened using bounded excerpts. Accepted rows received targeted source and operation tracing.
sampling: Purposive feasibility study; wall time is agent elapsed time, not an estimate of human annotation cost.
